06 / THE PRINT HANDOFF

What “ready to print”
actually means.

01

Choose the format.

Confirm card dimensions, quantity, whether the 365 cards are one box or several sets, and the chosen printer’s specifications.

02

Check every output.

Build exports to the vendor’s bleed, safe-zone, color, resolution, page-order and front/back requirements.

03

Approve the final proof.

Package 3 includes help submitting files to one printer and reviewing one digital proof before the order proceeds.

DAY 198 · A sample back from the materials provided
You approve the final printer order and pay the vendor directly. New packaging design, rewriting, new illustration, manufacturing and shipping are outside these packages.

07 / QUESTIONS ANSWERED

Here’s what you can
count on from me.

DO I NEED TO LEARN ANOTHER TOOL?

No.

We’ll start inside the Canva environment you already use. If there is a technical reason to use another tool, we’ll talk about it first.

ARE YOU REPLACING MY DESIGNS?

No.

Your message and visual identity remain yours. We’ll refine what already works and show you the samples before doing more.

HOW WILL I KNOW WHAT'S CHANGING?

You approve it.

First a representative front/back, then the agreed production changes. We keep a working copy and track the fixes.

WHEN CAN THEY GO TO PRINT?

After file review.

Once we know how the 365 cards are built and have the printer specifications, we can agree on a realistic production schedule.
